findings.title: Invalid reference to picocli.exit causes compilation failure
findings.body: The code calls `picocli.exit(CompatibilityResult.FEATURE_DISABLED);` but `picocli` is not a class, variable, or static import. The correct call is `CommandLine.exit(...)` (the `CommandLine` class is imported) or `System.exit(...)`. As written, the project will not compile.

findings.title: Feature-disabled test only covers metadata subcommand
findings.body: The new test `testFeatureNotEnabled` only invokes the `metadata` subcommand without the feature flag, verifying the error and exit code. The `check` subcommand has identical feature-gating logic but is not covered. A similar test for `check` would ensure the behavior is consistent and prevent regressions.
